name: Thaumaturgy (Rituals) — 3 Advanced — Eyes of the Ever Vigilant

system.description: Requiring three thaumaturges and a five-night ritual during which the eyes of seven vampires who lied to any of the three casters are boiled away in an alchemical compound, this ritual enchants a single structure so that Kindred within are unaffected by Obfuscate and Chimerstry, and any Obfuscated Nosferatu attempting to cross its threshold finds the Discipline failing outright. The enchantment lasts one year and may be renewed by any of the original casters reciting the incantation.
